page.search_description_1: The Friends of Hendricks is run entirely by parent volunteers. The mission, the 2026-27 board, and how to reach us.

section_1.paragraph_1: To increase the available funding to provide faculty and staff the additional resources required to ensure an exemplary education for the students of Hendricks Avenue Elementary School.
section_1.paragraph_2: Choosing to strengthen Hendricks Avenue Elementary through a gift to The Friends of Hendricks is a valuable and meaningful decision. Support can be given through time, talents, and monetary and in-kind donations. The effect of parents, alumni, grandparents, and friends standing together for our school will be immeasurable. All gifts, no matter how large or small, will have a powerful impact, because you become invested in the education and enrichment of every child, faculty, and staff member.
section_1.paragraph_3: The funds we raise are awarded through a grant process and are used to offset school budget cuts and increase financial resources for school enhancement, technology, and classroom needs.

section_1.caption_1: The Friends of Hendricks at the 2023 Walkathon. Everyone here is a parent volunteer — nobody draws a salary.
